tool_calls.literal:
/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.stack_frames[0], .value] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{sum["'$1]+=$2; if($2>0){pos[$1]+=$2;pn[$1]++}else{neg[$1]+=-$2;nn[$1]++}} END{for(k in sum) printf "%d'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%d\\t%d\\t%s\\n\",sum[k],pos[k],neg[k],pn[k],nn[k],k}' | sort -nr | head -30
jq -r '[.stack_frames[2], .value] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{sum["'$1]+=$2; if($2>0)pos[$1]+=$2;else neg[$1]+=-$2} END{for(k in sum) printf "%d'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%s\\n\",sum[k],pos[k],neg[k],k}' | sort -nr | head -30
jq -r '[.stack_frames[3], .value] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{sum["'$1]+=$2; if($2>0)pos[$1]+=$2;else neg[$1]+=-$2} END{for(k in sum) printf "%d'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%s\\n\",sum[k],pos[k],neg[k],k}' | sort -nr"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [.labels.comparison_side[0], .labels.source_session[0], .value] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{ops["'$1]+=$3; seen[$1 SUBSEP $2]=1} END{for(k in seen){split(k,a,SUBSEP); sess[a[1]]++} for(k in ops) print k, "operations=" ops[k], "sessions=" sess[k]}'"' | sort
jq -r '[.labels.comparison_side[0],.labels.source_session[0]]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | sort -u | awk -F '\\t' '{n["'$1]++}END{for(k in n) print k,n[k]}'"' | sort
jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [.stack_frames[2],.value]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{s["'$1]+=$2;p[$1]+=($2>0?$2:0);n[$1]+=($2<0?-$2:0)}END{for(k in s)printf "%d'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%s\\n\",s[k],p[k],n[k],k}' | sort -nr | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.labels.comparison_side[0],.value]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{v="'$2<0?-$2:$2; total[$1]+=v; if($1=="candidate") lines[$1]++; else lines[$1]++} END{for(k in total)print k,total[k],lines[k]}'"' | sort"
